Rules.InvariantScript: If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi) And gLoggedInTaxi.Occupied >= gLoggedInTaxi.Capacity, RGBA(220, 38, 38, 1), RGBA(17, 24, 39, 1))
If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi), "📍 " & gLoggedInTaxi.Position & "  ·  " & LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = gLoggedInTaxi.Position, label), "")

If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi) And gLoggedInTaxi.Occupied >= gLoggedInTaxi.Capacity, RGBA(220, 38, 38, 1), If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi) And gLoggedInTaxi.Occupied / Max(1, gLoggedInTaxi.Capacity) >= 0.75, RGBA(234, 179, 8, 1), RGBA(34, 197, 94, 1)))

If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi),
    Set(gTaxiIdx, LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = gLoggedInTaxi.Position, idx));
    ClearCollect(gSortedTrips,
        Sort(
            AddColumns(
                Filter(gTrips,
                    Status = "pending" Or
                    (Status = "accepted"    And TaxiFunkID = gLoggedInTaxi.FunkID) Or
                    (Status = "in_progress" And TaxiFunkID = gLoggedInTaxi.FunkID)
                ),
                "Score",
                If(Status = "pending",
                    Abs(LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = PickupZone, idx) - gTaxiIdx) +
                    Min(LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = PickupZone, idx), 11 - LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = PickupZone, idx)) * 0.5 +
                    If((gTaxiIdx <= 4 And LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = PickupZone, idx) <= 4) Or
                       (gTaxiIdx > 4  And LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = PickupZone, idx) > 4), 0, 2),
                    -1
                )
            ),
            Score,
            SortOrder.Ascending
        )
    )
)

If(ThisItem.OverflowWarning And ThisItem.Status = "pending", RGBA(252, 165, 165, 1), If(ThisItem.Status = "accepted" Or ThisItem.Status = "in_progress", RGBA(147, 197, 253, 1), RGBA(229, 231, 235, 1)))
ThisItem.PickupZone & If(IsBlank(ThisItem.PickupDetail) Or ThisItem.PickupDetail = "", "", " (" & ThisItem.PickupDetail & ")") & "  →  " & ThisItem.DropoffZone
LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = ThisItem.PickupZone, label) & "  →  " & LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = ThisItem.DropoffZone, label)

If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi),
  "⏱ ETA: " & If(
      Abs(LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = gLoggedInTaxi.Position, idx) - LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = ThisItem.PickupZone, idx)) = 0,
      "Bereits vor Ort",
      Text(Round(Abs(LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = gLoggedInTaxi.Position, idx) - LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = ThisItem.PickupZone, idx)) * 1.6, 0)) & " Min. bis Abholort"
  ),
  "")
["E – Echo","F – Foxtrot","H – Hotel","I – India","A – Alpha","B – Bravo","C – Charlie","D – Delta","T – Tango","G – Golf","P – Papa","W – Whisky"]
If(!IsBlank(gLoggedInTaxi), gLoggedInTaxi.Position & " – " & LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = gLoggedInTaxi.Position, label), "A – Alpha")
["E – Echo","F – Foxtrot","H – Hotel","I – India","A – Alpha","B – Bravo","C – Charlie","D – Delta","T – Tango","G – Golf","P – Papa","W – Whisky"]
["E – Echo","F – Foxtrot","H – Hotel","I – India","A – Alpha","B – Bravo","C – Charlie","D – Delta","T – Tango","G – Golf","P – Papa","W – Whisky"]
If(!IsBlank(gTripToComplete), gTripToComplete.DropoffZone & " – " & LookUp(gZoneMap, zone = gTripToComplete.DropoffZone, label), "A – Alpha")
